block.comment: Purpose: Move a servo and read a distance sensor as the basis of a scanning mechanism. Hardware: use Connections to check pin ownership for your selected board. Open the comment bubbles on the main steps for explanations.
Send this value/text to the computer. A new line finishes one record; same line can build a record from several values. Match Monitor/Plotter baud to the sketch.
Send this value/text to the computer. A new line finishes one record; same line can build a record from several values. Match Monitor/Plotter baud to the sketch.
Wait for the given number of milliseconds (1000 ms = 1 second). This pauses the main program; avoid long waits when loop must service motors, music files or serial input.
Send a target position to the named servo. The library keeps generating pulses; reaching the target takes mechanical time. Position mode uses degrees, pulse mode uses microseconds.
Repeat the body with angle taking each value from the start to the end, using the given step. Array indices start at zero.
Repeats until power is removed. Each block runs in order, then execution returns to the top. Keep this loop responsive when servicing motors, music or serial input.
